positive_sequences.name: service_installed_then_executed
positive_sequences.scenario: Service installed from a temporary path and then executed on the same host.
positive_sequences.rationale: Both stages share the host and the binary path alias inside the window.

positive_sequences.name: public_path_service_then_execution
positive_sequences.scenario: Service installed from the public directory and executed shortly afterwards.
positive_sequences.rationale: Both stages share the host and the binary path alias inside the window.

negative_sequences.name: execution_before_installation
negative_sequences.scenario: The binary executes before the service is installed.
negative_sequences.rationale: The ordered requirement is not satisfied.

negative_sequences.name: different_binary_paths
negative_sequences.scenario: A service is installed and a different binary executes.
negative_sequences.rationale: The binary path alias differs, so no group key contains both stages.

negative_sequences.name: different_hosts
negative_sequences.scenario: A service is installed on one host and the binary executes on another.
negative_sequences.rationale: The host component of the group key differs between the two stages.

notes: All sequences are synthetic and deterministic. Negative sequences break exactly one correlation requirement each: ordering, grouping, threshold, or timespan.
